help.title: Help
help.startClientInstruction: After starting the client, enter the TeamServer address (for example, {address}) and credentials on the login page, then click Log In
help.createListenerInstruction: Open the “Generate Listener” page and create an HTTP or HTTPS listener (enter the listener address and port)
help.generatePayloadInstruction: Click “Generate Beacon” on a listener card, choose the architecture and output format (EXE/DLL/Shellcode), then download and execute it on the target machine
help.waitOnlineInstruction: After the target machine runs the Payload, the dashboard automatically shows the new Agent (green dot = online)
help.interactionInstruction: Right-click an Agent row to open the menu: console, file browser, process management, network information, screenshots, BOF execution, and more
help.executeCommandInstruction: Enter a command in the console and press Enter to send it; enter {command} to view all available commands
help.dashboardDescription: Agent list and status overview. Supports filtering by hostname/IP/username. The context menu provides console, file browser, process management, network browser, Sleep adjustment, screenshots, BOF execution, cascade connection, and session exit/deletion.
help.topologyDescription: Displays cascade relationships between Agents graphically. Nodes can be dragged to arrange them, and right-clicking a node provides the same actions as the dashboard. Visualizes TCP/SMB cascade links.
help.generateListenerDescription: Manage listeners for HTTP/HTTPS/DNS/ExternalC2/SMB and other protocols. After creating a listener, generate a Beacon Payload from its card (supports EXE, DLL, Shellcode, and other formats).
help.proxyPivotDescription: Establish a SOCKS5 proxy or port-forwarding tunnel through a Beacon. Supports creating, pausing, resuming, and stopping tunnels. View tunnel status, transferred bytes, and disconnect reasons.
help.screenshotsDescription: Beacon screenshot list with Agent filtering, large-image preview, local saving, new screenshot requests, and deletion
help.downloadFilesDescription: List of files returned by the {command} command; click Save to export them to local disk
help.pluginsDescription: Add a directory containing {filename} to register a plugin. Plugin actions appear in the Agent context menu and support BOF / PostEx execution with custom parameters.
